name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Prince does not go with Godfrey if and only if Duke does not go with Wulfric.
Aldric goes with exactly two of Bridgegate, Duke, and 14 coins.
Knight goes with none of Wulfric, Oldwall, or 14 coins.
Godfrey goes with at most two of Oldwall, Prince, and 12 coins.
Either Millpond goes with Sheriff or Wulfric goes with Duke.
Exactly one of these is true: Bridgegate goes with 14 coins; Oldwall goes with Knight; Riverside goes with 12 coins.
The artisan in Riverside's levy is exactly 4 coins more than the artisan serving the Prince.
